name: Not a tax
note: fees, grants, licenses, fines, transfers, interest, reimbursements; not yet classified further

name: Personnel and benefits
note: object codes 5000-5999: salaries, overtime, pension and insurance contributions, training. Includes the health insurance reimbursement (110-4540), a contra account printed in the expense block

name: Contractual services
note: object codes 6000-6999: repairs and maintenance, professional services, utilities, insurance premiums, program disbursements

name: Supplies
note: object codes 7000-7899: office, fuel, operating supplies

name: Miscellaneous
note: object codes 7900-7999: miscellaneous expense, Heritage Days, other small lines the city prints outside its Supplies subtotal

name: Capital projects
note: object codes 8000-8199: street and storm projects

name: Transfers out
note: object codes 9000-9999: operating transfers out (reserves, capital, ARPA)

name: Water and sewer charges and fees
note: Water/Sewer Fund revenue: consumption (4500), connection fees (4510), deposits (4520), Dep on Agr (4521), meters sold (4530), other services (4590), card fee (4595)

name: Other water and sewer revenue
note: Water/Sewer Fund: grants, interest, miscellaneous, reimbursements, sale of assets, transfers in from reserves

name: Depreciation and bond set-asides
note: Water/Sewer Fund: unnumbered lines that move cash to the depreciation and bond payment funds (61-5-DDD-DEPSA / BONDSA are this project's pseudo account numbers)

name: Property tax and replacement tax levied for the fund
Other fund revenue (fees, rent, gifts, escrow)
